instance_props.failMessage: The bells clash and fall silent.
instance_props.solvedMessage: The last note hangs in the air. The tower mechanism unlocks.

instance_props.text: STRIKE AS THE DEAD RECALL|III · I · IV · II

props.text:
STRIKE AS THE DEAD RECALL
III · I · IV · II

instance_props.bodyText: The counterweights hang in the three corners of the cloister. When all three are set true, the tower will open. I should have burned this page, but I leave it for whoever comes after. Do not ring the bell. And if you must, know that it has always been rung for you.
